title: cloud: measure whether the hosted package disable route reaches the runtime disable door's dependent-rule refusal (#30379 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Filing gate: **① a named location**, from card #30379 (PR #30825, merged `1de7def003`). The seat named this follow-up in its ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

#30825 让框架的停用门在「别的包有生效校验规则读到要撤掉的字段」时拒绝停用。云端控制台停用包走的是云端自己的路由，没有测量过它是否经过这道检查。如果绕过了，云端照样会出现「停用后该对象所有写入失败」。这张卡先测量，绕过了就改成走同一道检查。

## Expected

1. Measure in objectstack-ai/cloud which route the hosted console's "disable package" calls, and whether it reaches `readDisableDependentRules` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` in objectstack).
2. If it bypasses the scan, route it through the framework door, or call the same verdict, so it answers `409 PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` with the same sentence. Pin it on a cloud serve.

Carrier: objectstack-ai/cloud (the route is cloud's); the verdict stays the framework's. Suggested grade: p2 · S · `repo:cloud`.
